from [[Pokémon Masters EX]] |location=Unknown |epnum=Pokémon Scarlet and Violet |epname=Pokémon Scarlet and Violet |gender=Male |ability={{a|Intimidate}} |tera={{t|Dark}} |firstevoep=Generation VII |firstevonametiming=Prior to |firstevoname=Pokémon Scarlet and Violet |evolution=1 |prevonum=0942 |evo1num=0943 |firststagename=Maschiff |current=[[Party|With]] [[Arven]] |media=game}} '''Arven's Mabosstiff''' (Japanese: '''ペパーのマフィティフ''' ''Peper's Mafitiff'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and a character in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}. It is [[Arven]]'s best friend, who's been with him while his parents were away and the reason Arven went after the [[Herba Mystica]]. ==In the core series games== ===History=== ====Background==== Mabosstiff was with [[Arven]] since it was a {{p|Maschiff}} and Arven was a kid, both living in [[Poco Path]]'s lighthouse alongside [[Professor Sada]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Professor Turo]]{{sup/9|V}}. At one point, Arven's parent left them to go back to their research on [[Area Zero]]'s [[Zero Lab]], leaving both Arven and Maschiff to take care of themselves, which greatly strengthened their bonds, since Maschiff was everything Arven had left. At some point, Maschiff evolved into a Mabosstiff. Sometime prior to the events of Scarlet and Violet, Arven and Mabosstiff tried to go down Area Zero to see his parent; however, they were attacked by an [[Paradox Pokémon|unknown Pokémon]], greatly injuring Mabosstiff. After leaving the crater, Arven tried to heal Mabosstiff with [[potion]]s and at the [[Pokémon Center]], but nothing worked, forcing him to go after the [[Herba Mystica]] as described in the [[Scarlet Book]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Violet Book]]{{sup/9|V}}. ===={{g|Scarlet and Violet}}==== =====Path of Legends===== After defeating the second [[Titan Pokémon]], Arven finally reveals to the {{player}} that he wanted to find the [[Herba Mystica]] to heal the wounds that Mabosstiff had received in [[Area Zero]]. As the duo defeated the Titans {{P|Klawf}}, {{P|Bombirdier}}, {{P|Orthworm}}, {{P|Great Tusk}}{{sup/9|S}}/{{P|Iron Treads}}{{sup/9|V}}, and {{P|Tatsugiri}}, they obtained the [[Sweet Herba Mystica|Sweet]], [[Bitter Herba Mystica|Bitter]], [[Salty Herba Mystica|Salty]], [[Sour Herba Mystica|Sour]], and [[Spicy Herba Mystica]], allowing Arven to make {{i|sandwich}}es with each of them to help his wounded Mabosstiff recover from its injuries. After it ate all five of them, Mabosstiff finally makes a full recovery. After [[Professor Sada|Sada]]{{sup/9|S}}/[[Professor Turo|Turo]]{{sup/9|V}} asked the player's help in Area Zero, Arven decided to come along and used Mabosstiff in a battle for the first time in the game to make sure they're ready. =====The Way Home===== Arven used Mabosstiff during their battles against the [[Paradox Pokémon]] in [[Area Zero]]. =====[[Mochi Mayhem]]===== When Arven was brainwashed by {{ga|Pecharunt}}'s [[mochi|Binding Mochi]], he used Mabosstiff to battle [[Kieran]] and the {{player}} alongside [[Penny]]. ===Personality and characteristics=== {{main|Mabosstiff (Pokémon)}} Mabosstiff took care of Arven back in [[Poco Path]] lighthouse when his parents weren't around to do so, growing to be Arven's best and only friend. ===In battle=== Arven will begin using Mabosstiff after it had fully recovered at the end of "Path of Legends". Mabosstiff will always be sent out last and be {{Tera}}stallized by Arven at the first opportunity. However, during [[Multi Battle]]s, Mabosstiff will always be sent out first and will not be Terastalized. Mabossiff uses the same moveset in all of his battles, with his level varying: * Level 63 during the second battle with Arven in [[Poco Path]] and during Multi Battles in [[Area Zero]]. * Level 68 during the {{Player}}'s first challenge in the [[Academy Ace Tournament]] and every subsquent challenge until [[The Indigo Disk]] is completed. * Level 76 after completing The Indigo Disk and winning the Academy Ace Tournament for the first time, as an opponent in the Academy Ace Tournament (prior to [[Mochi Mayhem]]). * Level 83 during [[Mochi Mayhem]] and all subsequent battles in the Academy Ace Tournament and [[Blueberry Academy]]'s [[League Club Room]]. {{Pokémon | gen=9 | ndex=0943 | pokemon=Mabosstiff | gender=male | level={{tt|63|Poco Path/Area Zero Multi Battle}}/{{tt|68|Mesagoza}}/{{tt|76|Mesagoza/Blueberry Academy}}/{{tt|83|Mossui Town Multi Battle/Mesagoza/Blueberry Academy}} | type1=Dark | tera=Dark | ability=Intimidate | move1=Crunch | move1type=Dark | move1cat=Physical | move2=Psychic Fangs | move2type=Psychic | move2cat=Physical | move3=Fire Fang | move3type=Fire | move3cat=Physical | move4=Play Rough | move4type=Fairy | move4cat=Physical }} ==In the spin-off games== ===Pokémon Masters EX=== {{main|Arven (Masters)#Mabosstiff|Arven (Masters) → Mabosstiff}} Mabosstiff appears alongside its Trainer in {{g|Masters EX}} as a [[sync pair]]. {{PairDex/h|dark}} {{PairDex|210|Arven|trainerlink=Arven (Masters)#Mabosstiff|trainerimg=Arven|0943|Mabosstiff|gender=male|buddy=yes|Dark|Bug|Support|exrole=Tech|6|Poké Fair Sync Pair Scout}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Arven Mabosstiff Adventures.png|thumb|250px|Mabosstiff in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Scarlet & Violet}}==== {{adv|Arven}} owned Mabosstiff since it was a {{p|Maschiff}}. Some time before the events of the Scarlet & Violet arc, Mabosstiff suffered injuries that couldn't be healed by conventional methods. Arven decided to search for the [[Herba Mystica]], hoping they could cure Mabosstiff's condition. It debuted in ''[[PASV02|Discover! The Quaking Earth Titan!!]]'', where Arven showed {{Violet}} it inside its Poké Ball really weakened. In order to catch a Pokémon to help take down the [[Titan Pokémon]] guarding the Herba Mystica, Arven reluctantly traded Mabosstiff to Violet for a {{p|Scovillain}}. He then caught a {{p|Smoliv}} and used her to trade back for his partner. As Arven and Violet defeated the Titan {{p|Klawf}}, {{p|Bombirdier}}, {{p|Orthworm}}, {{p|Iron Treads}}, and {{p|Great Tusk}}, Mabosstiff started to regain its strength after eating the [[Sweet Herba Mystica|Sweet]], [[Bitter Herba Mystica|Bitter]], [[Salty Herba Mystica|Salty]], and [[Sour Herba Mystica]] {{i|sandwich}}es that Arven made for it. Right after defeating the fake Titan {{p|Dondozo}} and making a sandwich out of the [[Spicy Herba Mystica]], the real Titan {{p|Tatsugiri}} showed up to stop them. Mabosstiff stepped up and scared it away, proving it had regained its strength. {{-}} ==In the TCG== This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Arven's Mabosstiff in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{card list/header|Arven's Pokémon|Darkness|nocat=yes}} {{card list/card|cardname={{TCG ID|Destined Rivals|Arven's Mabosstiff ex|139|Arven's Mabosstiff}}{{ex}}|type=Darkness|newmark=I|rows=4}} {{card list/release|type=Darkness|enset=Destined Rivals|enrarity=Double Rare|ennum=139/182|jpset=Hot Wind Arena|jprarity=RR|jpnum=052/063}} {{card list/release|type=Darkness|enset=Destined Rivals|enrarity=Ultra Rare|ennum=218/182|jpset=Hot Wind Arena|jprarity=SR|jpnum=081/063}} {{card list/release|type=Darkness|enset=Destined Rivals|enrarity=Special Illustration Rare|ennum=235/182|jpset=Hot Wind Arena|jprarity=SAR|jpnum=088/063}} {{card list/release|type=Darkness|jpset=SV-P Promotional cards|jpsymbol=SetSymbol SMPromo|jpnum=256/SV-P}} |} Mabosstiff also makes an appearance on the {{TCG|illustration rare}} {{TCG ID|Scarlet & Violet|Mabosstiff|218}} and {{TCG ID|Scarlet & Violet|Arven|166}} from {{TCG|Scarlet & Violet}}. ===Merchandise=== ====Hot Wind Arena Sealed Battle==== Hot Wind Arena Sealed Battles (Japanese: シールド戦 熱風のアリーナ) began to be held at participating Pokémon Card Gym sites on March 14, 2025, coinciding with the launch of the {{TCG|Hot Wind Arena}} subset. Locations typically charged for entry into these events, with an MRSP of ¥2,700 including tax. Entrants would receive 15 Hot Wind Arena booster packs and two participation prizes, which comprised one of two possible promotional prints of [[Nemona]] and a '''Paper Deck Case''' (Japanese: '''紙製デッキケース''') featuring [[Atsushi Furusawa]] artwork[https://x.com/full_atsushi/status/1912680781333557453 古澤あつし(Atsushi Furusawa) on Twitter] ([https://archive.is/VjyoW archived]) of [[Ethan]] and his {{p|Ho-Oh}}, [[Cynthia]] and her {{p|Garchomp}}, as well as [[Arven]] and his {{p|Mabosstiff}}. Like [[#SV9 accessories|the Battle Partners expansion]], a number of products depicted the [[Pokémon Trainer]]s that featured in the subset. All items were exclusive to Pokémon Centers and the Pokémon Center Online, with the look to possibly make them available at Pokémon Stores and on {{wp|Amazon (company)|Amazon's}} Pokémon storefront at a later date. *The '''Arven & Mabosstiff Sleeves''' (Japanese: '''デッキシールド ペパー＆マフィティフ''' ''Deck Shield: Peper & Mafitiff'') feature [[rival]] character [[Arven]] enjoying a picnic with his {{p|Mabosstiff}} and {{p|Greedent}}.
